name: codex-loop
description: /codex-loop <PR> hands Claude a review loop with the Codex GitHub bot: request a review, weigh each finding, fix or 👎 it, reply, resolve and repeat until 👍.

codexBotLogin.title: Codex bot login
codexBotLogin.description: GitHub login of the Codex review bot.

maxRounds.title: Maximum review rounds
maxRounds.description: Rounds of @codex review before the loop stops even without a 👍. /codex-loop <PR> --max <n> overrides it for one run.

waitMinutes.title: Wait for Codex (minutes)
waitMinutes.description: How long a round waits for Codex to answer before the loop stops.
